description: A monospace code panel with an optional mac-style window chrome and language badge. content.code is split on newlines and revealed line by line on a staggered spring, like a terminal typing itself out. Optional content.highlightLines (1-indexed) tints specific rows for callouts.

code.description: Raw source text; split on \n into rows, each revealed on its own stagger

language.description: Label shown in the badge, e.g. 'javascript', 'bash'

highlightLines.description: 1-indexed line numbers to tint with resolvedStyle.accentFill

monoFontFamily.description: raw CSS font-family stack; deliberately not a typography token since code needs a monospace face

badgeTypography.description: typography token for the language badge and line numbers

easing.description: easing token for each line's reveal spring

staggerFrames.description: target frames between line starts; auto-shrunk to fit the timing budget

showWindowChrome.description: show the mac-style traffic-light dots in the header bar

backgroundFill.description: raw hex for the panel background

lineNumberFill.description: raw hex for the gutter line numbers

accentFill.description: raw hex used for highlightLines tint and the window/badge accent
